title: Integrated circuit capable of performing dynamic voltage and frequency scaling operation based on workload and operating method thereof
snippet: 研究笔记：监测共享缓冲区及内存响应等待时间，根据 workload 分类决定电压—频率缩放系数。

title: Dynamic voltage scaling method of CPU using workload estimator and computer readable medium storing the method
snippet: 研究笔记：对程序代码段进行 workload profiling，并从电压设置点组合中选出能量消耗较小的组合。
